purpose: Place the exact carry congruence inside factorial-radix and Cantor-series arithmetic without mistaking a moving rational carrier for the digits of one fixed real number.

classification.discouraged_terminology: factorial digit theorem without stating that C_m changes with m
nearest_prior_work: Cantor (1869), Uber die einfachen Zahlensysteme, introduced the variable-radix series framework now called Cantor series.
Mance (2011), Section 1, defines Q-Cantor expansions x=floor(x)+sum E_n/(q_1...q_n) with 0<=E_n<q_n; choosing q_n=n gives factorial radix.
Hancl and Tijdeman (2008), Introduction, study irrationality of fixed factorial series sum b_n/n! and broader polynomial Cantor series.
classification.attribution: Attribute the numeral-system framework to Cantor and use modern Q-Cantor terminology after Mance. Describe residue extraction from a factorially scaled floor as standard mixed-radix arithmetic. Credit the local card only for the exact moving-C_m split and its Erdos #68 carry consumer.
classification.mathematical_interest: The congruence is elementary, but it is a clean diagnostic because it separates the forced integral residue from the only moving floor that can create a carry.
classification.reusable_scope: Any factorially cleared prefix with a controlled integral residue and an explicit fractional carrier admits the same reduction to one moving factorial-radix residue test.
classification.why_it_matters: It turns a divisibility event in the original sum into a single exact residue observable while preventing finite carry data from being promoted into an irrationality or recurrence claim.

mechanism_comparison.standard_core: For a fixed factorial expansion x=sum a_n/n!, the n-th digit equals floor(n!x)-n floor((n-1)!x), hence is congruent to floor(n!x) modulo n.
mechanism_comparison.local_delta: The exact prefix carrier is C_m=sum_{n<=m}1/[n!(n!-1)], while the full companion constant C=S-e+2 converts the same residue into a canonical factorial-digit condition. The finite congruence, infinite telescope, and two-sided miss windows are one mechanism, not parallel endpoint results.
mechanism_comparison.scalar_spectrum_subordination: The later scalar t_m=m·factorialGapPredecessorGap(m) packages the lower-cylinder, unit-carry, and upper-jump diagnostics as three level sets of one moving state. Its reconstruction through m=300000 is an exact finite implementation certificate and a route-selection diagnostic; it is not a uniform-distribution theorem or a new cofinality mechanism.
mechanism_comparison.rational_approximation_boundary: Classical Cantor-series irrationality criteria study a fixed infinite sum and its rational partial sums. The card supplies no tail inequality or nonvanishing argument capable of converting its congruence into irrationality.
mechanism_comparison.significance_boundary: The asset is a reusable exact normal form and finite-check interface; Erdos Problem 68 remains open.
